name: ledgerlens
description: Offline receipt OCR to accounting CSV, with anomaly detection over spend history. CPU-only, pure Node.

scripts.pipeline: npm run ocr -- samples --out data/raw && npm run parse -- data/raw --out data/ledger.csv && npm run analyze
scripts.test: node scripts/test.mjs && node scripts/test-analyze.mjs && node scripts/test-fixtures.mjs
